title: RealPage ban ordinance
requirement: The ordinance bans the use of rent-setting algorithms, such as RealPage, that utilize nonpublic data to determine rental prices.
exemptions: real estate agents, Multiple Listing Services (MLS)
quoted_span: The Jersey City Council unanimously approved (9-0) a measure banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage, as well as increasing benefits for laborers, at last night’s meeting.
